description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag ContentImageUrlTag that generates a URL for content images associated with a merchant store. It constructs the URL based on store configuration, request context, and provided image details.

classes.name: ContentImageUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag that generates a URL for merchant content images based on store configuration and request context.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Constructs and prints the image URL based on store details, configurations, and request context.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Completes processing of the tag, allowing JSP to continue rendering.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Sets the merchant store context for URL generation.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with this tag.

methods.name: setImageName
methods.description: Sets the image filename to be used in URL construction.

methods.name: setImageType
methods.description: Sets the type/category of the image.
